statements.statement: SELECT id, employee_id, full_name, gender, contact_number, position, CASE WHEN photo IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS has_photo, salary, status FROM employees WHERE delete_date IS NULL ORDER BY id

SELECT id, employee_id, full_name, gender, contact_number, position, CASE WHEN photo IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS has_photo, salary, status FROM employees WHERE delete_date IS NULL AND status = :status ORDER BY id
SELECT photo FROM employees WHERE employee_id = :employeeId AND delete_date IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(id) FROM employees WHERE delete_date IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(id) FROM employees WHERE delete_date IS NULL AND status = :status
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employees WHERE delete_date IS NULL AND employee_id = :employeeId

INSERT INTO employees (employee_id, full_name, gender, contact_number, position, photo, salary, insert_date, status) VALUES (:employeeId, :fullName, :gender, :contactNumber, :position, :photo, :salary, :insertDate, :status)

UPDATE employees SET full_name = :fullName, gender = :gender, contact_number = :contactNumber, position = :position, status = :status, update_date = :updateDate WHERE employee_id = :employeeId AND delete_date IS NULL
UPDATE employees SET photo = :photo, update_date = :updateDate WHERE employee_id = :employeeId AND delete_date IS NULL
UPDATE employees SET salary = :salary, update_date = :updateDate WHERE employee_id = :employeeId AND delete_date IS NULL
UPDATE employees SET delete_date = :deleteDate WHERE employee_id = :employeeId AND delete_date IS NULL
